All command/KIT/END/fault edges unchanged (cycle-exact differential vs frozen v1, 9 modes). Same ports, same S-DIE 540x86.4 E-anchored grant (sdie_codex_c10_540_candidate_1016) and pin plan; recipe 3 pin registers as localtree3.
